 Early leaders Bagan face Odisha with chance to widen gap at the top
 Early leaders Bagan face Odisha with chance to widen gap at the top
 04 Nov, 2026 Share Share Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on WhatsApp Copy Link Close Mariners Look To Extend Their Dominant Run, While Juggernauts Aim To Spark Turnaround. 
 Kolkata: Mohun Bagan Super Giant will look to consolidate their position on top of the MG ISL table when they host Odisha FC at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan on Thursday. The Mariners have collected nine points from four matches, while Odisha have managed two points from their opening three outings. 
 The Mariners have shown ruthless efficiency in recent weeks, recovering from an early setback to string together three consecutive victories. Their latest 2-1 win over Punjab FC highlighted the quality of their attacking options, with Lee Erwin and Dejan Dražić both finding the back of the net. Adding to Odisha FC's defensive concerns is the return of Australian striker Jamie Maclaren, who is back in the squad after recovering from injury. Maclaren famously dismantled the Juggernauts with a four-goal masterclass the last time these two sides met at the Salt Lake Stadium, in a 5-1 host victory. 
 Head coach Panagiotis Dilmperis wants his side to show intent from the opening whistle. “The team should start from the first second with more concentration and more aggressiveness,” he said. Dilmperis also acknowledged the responsibility that comes with being at the top of the table, adding, “I don't know if this is a fact that is going to give us confidence, but for sure it will make us be more responsible.” Bagan will be without Sahal Abdul Samad, who suffered a knee injury against Punjab FC, and Miguel Figueira, who scored the winner against Sporting Club Delhi in the Mariners' first victory of the season. 
 Odisha FC, meanwhile, will look to build on consecutive draws against Inter Kashi and NorthEast United FC. Head coach TG Purushothaman has acknowledged the need for more creativity in midfield and a sharper attacking approach, but believes his side can take confidence from its defensive improvement. 
 After keeping a first clean sheet against NorthEast, Odisha will need to maintain that discipline against the league leaders. Purushothaman underlined the importance of the fixture, saying, “It is a match for survival. That is how we will have to approach it.” He also pointed to the experience of facing NorthEast United as preparation for the challenge ahead: “We know how to deal with all the situations and that gives us confidence.” 
 With Bagan seezing a fourth consecutive win and Odisha desperate to get their campaign moving, both sides have plenty at stake in Kolkata. 
 The match kicks off at 7:30 PM IST on Thursday, November 5, at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan, and will be broadcast live on Sony Sports Network, with free streaming available on YouTube.
